activity_summary: At the brook she asked whether London is where you work or where you live. You said both, and that a man may have a trade in one town and a house in another. She said that was three answers. She left it, and asked the price of London butter. You had Thursday's fourpence, and no London price. You did not replace the first answer.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said both, and did not replace it with a single answer.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked once, counted three, left it, and asked about London butter.

facets.activity: Gave three answers at the brook

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: I'll ask one thing and then leave it. Is London where you work, Will, or where you live?

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: That was three answers. I asked for one.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Both. A man may have a trade in one town and a house in another.
